rationale: Base station storage was at 99% with loop recording disabled, triggering error E-402 and stopping new event recordings after the 3rd. Live view worked because it does not depend on local storage. Enabling loop recording immediately restored new clip recording, confirming the root cause.

repair_steps: Confirm loop recording is enabled on the base station (Base Station Settings > Storage > Loop Recording).
Advise customer to export any important existing clips before formatting storage if they want to keep them.
If storage remains near full, guide customer to format storage after export to free space.
Verify new event clips are being recorded and error E-402 is cleared.
output.customer_reply: We've resolved the issue. Your base station storage was full and loop recording was off, so new events weren't being saved. I've enabled loop recording, and new clips are now recording normally. If you want to keep any existing clips, please export them soon, as older clips may be overwritten. Let us know if you need further help!

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).
